# Orrery

> Orrery is a browser-based solar system explorer, mission simulator, encyclopedia, station explorer and spaceflight fleet inventory: SvelteKit + TypeScript + Three.js r128, static JSON data, 14 locales, self-hosted on a VPS (www.orrerylearn.com), plus a Physics Lab with two Node services (lab-api, mcp).

[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) holds the rules for every coding agent; read it first. [docs/adr/TA.md](docs/adr/TA.md) is the one-page architecture map: every route, subsystem, contract and constraint with the decision that locked it.

Decisions live in ADRs (locked), RFCs (architecture in flight), PRDs (product scope), UXS / UXD (UI specs and decisions); each type has an index with one line per document. Folders with a README.md module map say which file owns what; read it before editing there.

Paths are relative to the repository root. This file is generated by `scripts/build-llms-txt.mjs` from `scripts/llms/llms-hand.mjs` and the docs themselves; do not edit it by hand.

- [Stack — locked decisions](AGENTS.md#stack--locked-decisions): Do not propose alternatives.
- [Repository structure](AGENTS.md#repository-structure): The folder tree: routes, lib modules, static data, scripts, tests and docs.
- [Tooling index — what to run, and when](AGENTS.md#tooling-index--what-to-run-and-when): Before reaching for a script, check docs/reference/tooling/ — the canonical map of every standing tool (build/CI, data validation, image pi…
- [Clean up after yourself — run the cleanup tool when you're done](AGENTS.md#clean-up-after-yourself--run-the-cleanup-tool-when-youre-done): When you finish a work block on a worktree — deployed, tested, compared, fixed, whatever — leave the machine quiet.
- [Audio narration — read before touching `src/lib/audio-*` or `scripts/audio/`](AGENTS.md#audio-narration--read-before-touching-srclibaudio--or-scriptsaudio): v0.7 ships an in-overlay narrated episode system (PRD-016 / RFC-019). en-US only — v0.8 adds the Anthropic translation pipeline + 12-locale…
- [i18n rules — follow these exactly](AGENTS.md#i18n-rules--follow-these-exactly): Translation model tier (cost policy).
- [Data layer rules](AGENTS.md#data-layer-rules): All data access goes through src/lib/data.ts.
- [Image pipeline — gotchas](AGENTS.md#image-pipeline--gotchas): Full pipeline reference: scripts/IMAGE-PIPELINE.md — end-to-end flow, every script's role, the "Adding a new gallery image" runbook, worked…
- [Mobile-first rules](AGENTS.md#mobile-first-rules): Design at 375px first.
- [Physics — do not change without ADR](AGENTS.md#physics--do-not-change-without-adr): All orbital mechanics use Keplerian two-body formulation.
- [Performance — 3D scene discipline (do not regress)](AGENTS.md#performance--3d-scene-discipline-do-not-regress): The /earth /moon /mars /iss /tiangong /explore /fly scenes are GPU- and main-thread-sensitive.
- [Debugging — `?debug=1` is the in-app inspector](AGENTS.md#debugging--debug1-is-the-in-app-inspector): Every route surfaces a built-in DebugPanel when you append ?debug=1 to the URL (e.g. /fly?debug=1, /mars?debug=1, /?debug=1).
- [Adding any card / entity — universal invariants](AGENTS.md#adding-any-card--entity--universal-invariants): Before the specific checklists below (flyby body, mission, science overlay, fleet row), every new card / entity / catalog entry must clear…
- [Adding a new flyby body to `/fly` — repeatable checklist](AGENTS.md#adding-a-new-flyby-body-to-fly--repeatable-checklist): Use this when adding a new destination (planet / dwarf / comet / asteroid / KBO) so its flyby beat composes an iconic hero shot.
- [Race-free `/fly` test hooks — when chrome-devtools-mcp shares its browser](AGENTS.md#race-free-fly-test-hooks--when-chrome-devtools-mcp-shares-its-browser): If a second Claude Code session is using chrome-devtools-mcp on the same Chrome instance, click/scrub events race the automation (the other…
- [Testing rules](AGENTS.md#testing-rules): Unit tests (Vitest, colocated): every exported function under src/lib/orbital/ and src/lib/physics/ must have tests.
- [Design system — do not change without UXS update](AGENTS.md#design-system--do-not-change-without-uxs-update): Colour tokens (one blue accent, no teal or cyan), the type scale, page shell, chips, pins and the scale bar, with the specs that enforce them.
- [CI — what runs on every PR](AGENTS.md#ci--what-runs-on-every-pr): E2e (Playwright) runs on push to main, not on every PR.
- [Documentation system](AGENTS.md#documentation-system): Reading order for any non-trivial task: TA.md, then ADRs, RFCs, PRDs, UXS and the i18n style guide.
- [What not to do](AGENTS.md#what-not-to-do): Do not hardcode UI strings — use Paraglide-js

## By service

### orrery-web

The static app behind nginx on the prod VPS; browser errors to GlitchTip `orrery-prod` (18), `vite dev` to `orrery-dev` (30); Umami prod and dev sites.

- [docs/guides/observability.md](docs/guides/observability.md): Observability — GlitchTip (client errors) + Umami (usage) + docker logs
- [docs/ops/deploy-prod-vps.md](docs/ops/deploy-prod-vps.md): Deploy orrery to prod VPS — operator runbook
- [docs/ops/prod-validator.md](docs/ops/prod-validator.md): Prod deployment validator — `scripts/validate-prod.mjs`
- [docs/adr/ADR-082.md](docs/adr/ADR-082.md): ADR-082 — Telemetry environment ladder (dev → staging → prod, isolated projects)
- [docs/adr/ADR-097.md](docs/adr/ADR-097.md): ADR-097 — No staging tier: releases go straight to prod, GitHub Pages serves only the docs

### orrery-lab-api

The Lab’s OAuth 2.1 server and /ask (Node); errors to GlitchTip `orrery-lab-api` (31) in prod, `orrery-dev` (30) in dev; traces to VictoriaTraces.

- [docs/rfc/RFC-037.md](docs/rfc/RFC-037.md): RFC-037 · Physics Kernel — the technical architecture for the Lab subsystem + MCP server
- [docs/adr/ADR-094.md](docs/adr/ADR-094.md): ADR-094 — Server-side observability for lab-api and mcp (errors, traces, metrics, access logs, analytics, LLM)
- [docs/guides/observability.md](docs/guides/observability.md): Observability — GlitchTip (client errors) + Umami (usage) + docker logs

### orrery-mcp

The MCP server exposing the Lab formulas (Node); errors to GlitchTip `orrery-mcp` (32) in prod, `orrery-dev` (30) in dev.

- [docs/rfc/RFC-037.md](docs/rfc/RFC-037.md): RFC-037 · Physics Kernel — the technical architecture for the Lab subsystem + MCP server
- [docs/adr/ADR-094.md](docs/adr/ADR-094.md): ADR-094 — Server-side observability for lab-api and mcp (errors, traces, metrics, access logs, analytics, LLM)

### retired

The staging rung (GitHub Pages app mirror, GlitchTip `orrery` 6, Umami staging site) is gone since 2026-11.

- [docs/adr/ADR-097.md](docs/adr/ADR-097.md): ADR-097 — No staging tier: releases go straight to prod, GitHub Pages serves only the docs
